pages.text: $(bold)Species:$() Land$(br)$(bold)Habitat:$() forests$(br2)A Land dragon that makes its home among the trees. Forest dragons are the most commonly encountered subspecies.

pages.title: Forest Dragon Egg
pages.text: Each subspecies lays an egg of its own colour. Place the egg in a $(l:plants_and_items/nest)Dragon Nest$() to keep it safe.
